name: M3_MWS411MI_LstDelLnByOrd
description: List delivery lines linked to specific reference orders based on order category, order number, order line, and line suffix. The operation returns one row per delivery line that matches the supplied references, showing how order lines are allocated into deliveries. Output includes references back to the delivery and order, item and facility identification, quantities in basic and alternate units, weights, volume, and several status and control indicators. Data is read-only and reflects the current state of each delivery line in M3.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Reference order category used to identify the type of order whose delivery lines to list.

inputParameters.name: RIDN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number used to select delivery lines to list.

inputParameters.name: RIDL
inputParameters.description: Order line number on the reference order used to select specific delivery lines.

inputParameters.name: RIDX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line used to select specific delivery lines.

outputParameters.name: DLIX
outputParameters.description: Delivery number for the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Reference order category indicating the type of order the delivery line originates from.

outputParameters.name: RIDN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number for the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: RIDL
outputParameters.description: Order line number on the reference order for the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: RIDX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the sequence within the reference order line for the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number associated with the delivery line.

outputParameters.name: POPN
outputParameters.description: Alias number used as an alternative identifier for the item on this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: ALWT
outputParameters.description: Alias category defining the type of alias number used for the item on this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: ALWQ
outputParameters.description: Alias qualifier providing additional classification for the item's alias number.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity for the delivery line in the item's basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PLQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity from this delivery line printed on a picking list in the basic unit of measure but not yet confirmed.

outputParameters.name: PHLD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the delivery line is on pick hold and blocked from appearing on picking lists.

outputParameters.name: STCD
outputParameters.description: Inventory accounting code indicating how stock for this delivery line is handled in inventory and planning.

outputParameters.name: JDCD
outputParameters.description: Joint delivery code grouping order lines that must be delivered together.

outputParameters.name: BLOP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this delivery number is blocked for use during order line entry.

outputParameters.name: TRQA
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity for the delivery line in an alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PLQA
outputParameters.description: Quantity from this delivery line printed on a picking list in an alternate unit of measure but not yet confirmed.

outputParameters.name: ALUN
outputParameters.description: Alternate unit of measure used to express quantities for this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: GRWE
outputParameters.description: Gross weight of the quantity on this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: NEWE
outputParameters.description: Net weight of the quantity on this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: VOL3
outputParameters.description: Volume of the quantity on this delivery line.

outputParameters.name: FCU1
outputParameters.description: Estimated free capacity associated with this delivery line in an internal unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: NOWA
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the delivery line is excluded from wave-based combined picking.

outputParameters.name: LSHL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the delivery line is on stop ship hold because the last ship date has passed.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the delivery line record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the delivery line record was created.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the delivery line record was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Sequential change number for the delivery line record.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person who last changed the delivery line record.

outputParameters.name: LMTS
outputParameters.description: Timestamp of the last modification to the delivery line record.

outputParameters.name: SCNB
outputParameters.description: Supply chain number linking the delivery line to its supply chain.

outputParameters.name: SCES
outputParameters.description: Status code showing the delivery line's regrouping stage, such as preliminary, planned, or firm.
